transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got an approved customer order for 18 replacement impellers that need to be produced in the additive-manufacturing bay. Both Printer P1 and Printer P2 can handle this geometry. P1 is our usual machine for this product, and P2 is available for the production window as well. Before we finalize the run plan in today's huddle, I need to check with each of you on readiness. Can quality, maintenance, materials, and EHS each give me a status update so we can determine the best way to split or assign this run across the two printers?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a quality requirement before we finalize the run plan. I reviewed drawing revision C in the quality document system, and release requires a computed-tomography scan of all 18 impellers plus tensile testing of exactly 4 witness coupons. The revision notice is still awaiting my quality-system acknowledgment, so this needs to be factored into our readiness check.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical maintenance issue before we finalize the run plan. My inspection found that Printer P1's recoater calibration is overdue, so P1 must not be used for this run. Printer P2 is ready, but changing its build plate requires exactly 90 minutes before the build can start. I also haven't closed the inspection ticket yet, so I'll need to do that once we confirm the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a materials readiness item before we finalize the run plan. I've verified the material certificate for powder lot MP-77 and calculated that exactly 23 kg must be reserved for the 18 impellers, the 4 witness coupons, and the required process allowance. The certificate is still sitting in the receiving folder pending materials-system entry, so I'll need to get that entered before we can proceed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an EHS safety requirement before we finalize the run plan. My review of the updated powder safety data sheet classifies this lot as combustible dust, which requires an inert-gas purge and documented bonding verification before the build can start. I'm still waiting on EHS signoff to post the revised bay instruction, so this needs to be factored into our readiness check.
transcript.speaker: A5
